name: Galvoni III
description: Galvoni III was an Imperial planet in the Core Worlds' Galvoni system with a military communications complex.
lead_paragraphs: Galvoni III was an Imperial planet in the Core Worlds' Galvoni system with a military communications complex.
Shortly after the Battle of Yavin, Voren Na'al infiltrated the Imperial Records Office to gather information about the construction, function, personnel and destruction of the Death Star.
